title: Z.RPG Development progress post — j2dme inspired action-rpg looter-shooter
author: UnusualConclusion158
selftext:
My [first showcase](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1xrvvzm/stalker_doom_rpg_lootershooterinspired_game_zrpg/) (check the first post to see how the game used to look) was almost 3 weeks ago, and while I made solid progress, I couldn't build a playable demo as quickly as I'd hoped. IRL got harder; OpenAI got greedier with their "compute". But the development is still on!

First of all, the game finally has a main menu. It uses a live-rendering scene from the game

![img](nbgf458qaz3i1 "Main menu. It's Dynamic and can change depending on the in-game progress.")

Secondly, UI was addresed. It's still far from done, but on PC it looks much more usable and less clustered.

![img](j1rmpve6bz3i1 "Old PC UI from the first showcase")

![img](ixsitnihbz3i1 "Current PC UI — still not done")

Thirdly, lots of work was put into graphics. 114 scenery props that were 2d sprites where re-done in 3D. All of the randomly generated structures were remade too, with improved textures and extra details added.

![img](bly3xqmxbz3i1 "Position and type of structures and decorations are random per raid, but are contextually connected to the location you are on.")

Also, all locations will get so-called "signature" structures. These are specific buildings or objects that you can meet only at the exact raiding location, with a random chance. Territories around are still random. For example, you can visit the Flea Market on the Garbage. 

![img](zzs1ug0ccz3i1 "Flea market signature structure")

  
Terrain and vegetation were updated. Dynamic lightning and shadows were added to the game. Fog, rain and storms now come up more often and hang around longer. I rebuilt the skybox so the clouds drift with the wind, and the sun you see in the sky is the same one casting shadows on the ground.

![img](ua6647czcz3i1 "The game can look surprisingly atmospheric sometimes. Ambient and various \"sounds of nature\" are also in the game.")

https://i.redd.it/9l22tk13dz3i1.png

Finally, I managed to deal with the absence of "impact" during battles. I wanted shooting to give you a better sense of where your rounds went. Enemies flinch when they’re hit and get wounded, metal throws sparks, and brick kicks up dust. The game resolves a burst in one turn, but you can see the individual impacts as the shots land.

![video](2b82mvkddz3i1 "Some underground gameplay with shooting impact.")

My main task right now is to create a demo that includes the full first act of the game, with all the content, loot, and quests available for public testing. Balance is still an issue too, game can be too difficult or too easy from run to run.
